e:not(.v90-explore) #v35Content .v36-shell-head{padding:12px 16px}body.v90-onhome:not(.v90-explore) #st170Launch{border-radius:19px}}

#st170Launch #st175Settings .st170-home-options{margin-top:14px}
#st170Launch #st170Go{min-width:min(100%,245px);font-size:19px;padding:15px 23px}
#st170Launch #st175Now{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
body.st175-playing .viewerbar :is(#back,#forward,#bookmark,#helpBtn,#st170Quick){display:none!important}
body.st175-playing .viewerbar #home{margin-left:auto}
#st170Focus .st175-extra{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;color:#3c554d}
#st170Focus .st175-extra summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
#st170Launch #st170Review{background:transparent;box-shadow:none;color:#275d48;border:1px solid #b1d0bd}
@media(max-width:460px){#st170Launch .st170-home-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}#st170Launch #st170Go{width:100%}}
</style>
<script id="st172-shell">
/* Quick lessons: resume and optional local review. Legacy course progress remains separate. */
(()=>{
'use strict';
const KEY='studytable:autopilot:v170',OLD='studytable:autopilot:v169';
const modes=['easy','medium','hard'],available=()=>window.studyTableFullCourses?.courses||[];
const DAY=86400000;
let state={subject:'',mode:'easy',sessionBySubject:{},reviewBySubject:{},dueBySubject:{},finishedCourses:{},activeReview:null};
try{
 const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');
 if(saved&&typeof saved==='object')state={...state,...saved};
 else {const old=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(OLD)||'null');if(old&&typeof old==='object'){state.mode=modes.includes(old.mode)?old.mode:'easy';state.subject=String(old.subject||'');for(const [subject,unit] of Object.entries(old.nextBySubject||{})){state.sessionBySubject[subject]={unit,stage:0}}}}
}catch{}
if(!modes.includes(state.mode))state.mode='easy';
if(!state.sessionBySubject||typeof state.sessionBySubject!=='object')state.sessionBySubject={};
if(!state.reviewBySubject||typeof state.reviewBySubject!=='object')state.reviewBySubject={};
if(!state.finishedCourses||typeof state.finishedCourses!=='object'||Array.isArray(state.finishedCourses))state.finishedCourses={};
if(!state.dueBySubject||typeof state.dueBySubject!=='object'||Array.isArray(state.dueBySubject))state.dueBySubject={};
if(!state.activeReview||typeof state.activeReview!=='object')state.activeReview=null;
let pending=null;
function noteOutcome(c,unit,outcome){if(!c.unitIds.includes(unit)||!['miss','helped','seen','clear','self'].includes(outcome))return;
 const records=state.dueBySubject[c.subject]||{};const prev=records[unit];
 if(outcome==='clear'||outcome==='self'){const step=prev?Math.min(2,(prev.step||0)+1):0;records[unit]={due:Date.now()+[3,7,14][step]*DAY,step};}
 else records[unit]={due:Date.now()+DAY,step:0};
 state.dueBySubject[c.subject]=records;store();refresh();}
const validSubject=(subject)=>available().find(c=>c.subject===subject);
function store(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state))}catch{}}
if(!state.v175Expanded){for(const subject of ['spanish','piano','chess','calculus','physics','medicine','business']){if(state.finishedCourses[subject]){state.finishedCourses[subject]=false;state.sessionBySubject[subject]={unit:'st175-'+subject+'-01',stage:0,stepIndex:1}}}state.v175Expanded=true;store()}
function choose(){const list=available();if(!list.length)return null;const previous=window.studyTableFullCourses?.readingPlace?.();return validSubject(state.subject)||validSubject(previous?.subject)||list[0]}
function savedPlace(course){const rec=state.sessionBySubject[course.subject];if(rec&&course.unitIds.includes(rec.unit))return {unit:rec.unit,stage:Number.isInteger(rec.stage)?rec.stage:0,stepIndex:Number.isInteger(rec.stepIndex)?rec.stepIndex:1,bonus:!!rec.bonus,needsHelp:!!rec.needsHelp};const place=window.studyTableFullCourses?.readingPlace?.();return {unit:place?.subject===course.subject&&course.unitIds.includes(place.unit)?place.unit:course.unitIds[0],stage:0,stepIndex:1,bonus:false,needsHelp:false}}
function dueFor(c){const entries=state.dueBySubject[c.subject]||{};return Object.entries(entries).filter(([unit,rec])=>c.unitIds.includes(unit)&&Number.isFinite(rec?.due)&&rec.due<=Date.now()).sort((a,b)=>a[1].due-b[1].due).map(([unit])=>unit)}
function refresh(){const course=choose();const pick=document.getElementById('st170Subject');if(pick&&course)pick.value=course.subject;const mode=document.getElementById('st170Mode');if(mode)mode.value=state.mode;const go=document.getElementById('st170Go');if(go&&course){const saved=state.sessionBySubject[course.subject];go.textContent=dueFor(course).length?'Review one thing':state.finishedCourses[course.subject]?'Start again':saved?'Continue':'Start learning'}const now=document.getElementById('st175Now');if(now&&course){const p=savedPlace(course),i=Math.max(0,course.unitIds.indexOf(p.unit));now.textContent=dueFor(course).length?course.title+' · A quick review, then your next lesson.':course.title+' · Lesson '+(state.finishedCourses[course.subject]?'complete':(i+1)+' of '+course.unitIds.length)+'. Just a few minutes.'}const review=document.getElementById('st170Review');if(review&&course){const count=(Array.isArray(state.reviewBySubject[course.subject])?state.reviewBySubject[course.subject]:[]).filter(id=>course.unitIds.includes(id)).length;review.hidden=count===0;review.textContent=count?`Try again (${count})`:''}}
function launch(data={}){
 const c=choose();if(!c)return;state.subject=c.subject;
 const place=savedPlace(c),inProgress=!data.skipReview&&!data.unit&&state.activeReview?.subject===c.subject&&c.unitIds.includes(state.activeReview.unit)?state.activeReview:null;
 const due=!data.skipReview&&!data.unit&&!inProgress?dueFor(c):[];
 const isReview=!!data.review||!!inProgress||due.length>0;
 const reviewUnit=data.unit||inProgress?.unit||due[0];
 const restarting=!!state.finishedCourses[c.subject]&&!data.unit&&!isReview;
 const unit=isReview?reviewUnit:(data.unit&&c.unitIds.includes(data.unit))?data.unit:restarting?c.unitIds[0]:place.unit;
 const stage=(data.unit||restarting)?(Number.isInteger(data.stage)?data.stage:0):place.stage;
 const stepIndex=(data.unit||restarting)?(Number.isInteger(data.stepIndex)?data.stepIndex:1):place.stepIndex;
 const bonus=(data.unit||restarting)?!!data.bonus:!!place.bonus;
 const needsHelp=(data.unit||restarting)?!!data.needsHelp:!!place.needsHelp;
 if(isReview){state.activeReview=inProgress||{subject:c.subject,returnPlace:place,unit}}else{
  state.activeReview=null;state.finishedCourses[c.subject]=false;
 }
 if(data.mode&&modes.includes(data.mode))state.mode=data.mode;
 store();pending={subject:c.subject,unit,stage:isReview?0:stage,stepIndex:isReview?1:stepIndex,bonus:isReview?false:bonus,needsHelp:isReview?false:needsHelp,mode:state.mode,review:isReview};
 window.studyTableFullCourses?.open(c.subject,unit);
 const frame=document.getElementById('frame');if(frame?.contentWindow){try{frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'st170-start',...pending},'*')}catch{}}
 refresh();
}
function setDifficulty(v){if(!modes.includes(v))return;state.mode=v;store();refresh();const frame=document.getElementById('frame');if(frame?.contentWindow)frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'st170-mode',mode:v},'*')}
function review(){const c=choose();if(!c)return;const outstanding=(Array.isArray(state.reviewBySubject[c.subject])?state.reviewBySubject[c.subject]:[]).filter(id=>c.unitIds.includes(id));if(!outstanding.length)return;launch({unit:outstanding[0],mode:'easy',review:true})}
function mount(){const hero=document.getElementById('v90Hero');const list=available();if(!hero||!list.length||document.getElementById('st170Launch'))return;
 const c=choose();if(!state.subject)state.subject=c.subject;
 const el=document.createElement('section');el.id='st170Launch';el.setAttribute('aria-label','Quick lessons');
 el.innerHTML='<div class="st170-home-eyebrow">A little each day</div><h2>Ready for one lesson?</h2><p id="st175Now">Just a few minutes. Pick up where you stopped.</p><div class="st170-home-buttons"><button type="button" id="st170Go">Continue</button><button type="button" id="st170Review" hidden>Try something again</button></div><details id="st175Settings"><summary>Change subject or difficulty</summary><div class="st170-home-options"><label>Subject<select id="st170Subject"></select></label><label>Difficulty<select id="st170Mode"><option value="easy">Easy · show me</option><option value="medium">Medium · let me try</option><option value="hard">Hard · test me</option></select></label></div></details><p class="st170-home-foot">Your place is saved on this device. You can switch subjects any time.</p>';
 const select=el.querySelector('#st170Subject');for(const course of list){const opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=course.subject;opt.textContent=course.title;select.append(opt)}
 select.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(!validSubject(e.target.value))return;state.subject=e.target.value;store();refresh()});el.querySelector('#st170Mode').addEventListener('change',e=>setDifficulty(e.target.value));el.querySelector('#st170Go').addEventListener('click',()=>launch());el.querySelector('#st170Review').addEventListener('click',review);
 const before=hero.querySelector('#st160-spark')||hero.querySelector('.v90-actions');if(before)before.before(el);else hero.append(el);const spark=hero.querySelector('#st160-spark');if(spark&&!spark.closest('.st173-more')){const more=document.createElement('details');more.className='st173-more';const title=document.createElement('summary');title.textContent='Try something different';more.append(title);spark.before(more);more.append(spark)}refresh();}
function wireLearningHome(){
 const b=document.getElementById('home');if(!b||b.dataset.st174Wired)return;
 b.dataset.st174Wired='1';b.textContent='Learning home';
 b.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(typeof showHome!=='function'||typeof v35Open!=='function')return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  document.body.classList.remove('st175-playing');showHome();v35Open('home');
 },true);
}
function quickButton(){const bar=document.querySelector('.viewerbar');if(!bar||document.getElementById('st170Quick'))return;const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.id='st170Quick';b.textContent='Start a lesson';b.addEventListener('click',()=>launch());bar.prepend(b)}
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{const frame=document.getElementById('frame');if(!frame||e.source!==frame.contentWindow)return;const d=e.data;if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;const c=validSubject(d.subject);
 if(d.type==='st170-ready'){if(c&&pending&&pending.subject===d.subject){frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'st170-start',...pending},'*');pending=null}return}
 if(!c||pending&&d.subject!==pending.subject)return;
 if(d.type==='st176-outcome'&&c.unitIds.includes(d.unit)){noteOutcome(c,d.unit,d.outcome);return}
 if(d.type==='st176-review-finished'&&state.activeReview?.subject===c.subject){const ret=state.activeReview.returnPlace;state.activeReview=null;store();launch({unit:ret.unit,stage:ret.stage,stepIndex:ret.stepIndex,bonus:ret.bonus,needsHelp:ret.needsHelp,skipReview:true});return}
 if(d.type==='st170-mode'&&modes.includes(d.mode)){state.mode=d.mode;store();refresh();return}
 if(d.type==='st170-state'){document.body.classList.add('st175-playing')}if(d.type==='st170-exit'){document.body.classList.remove('st175-playing');return}
 if(d.type==='st170-state'&&c.unitIds.includes(d.unit)&&modes.includes(d.mode)&&Number.isInteger(d.stage)&&d.stage>=0&&d.stage<5){if(!state.activeReview||state.activeReview.subject!==c.subject){state.sessionBySubject[c.subject]={unit:d.unit,stage:d.stage,stepIndex:Number.isInteger(d.stepIndex)?Math.max(1,Math.min(d.stepIndex,30)):1,bonus:!!d.bonus,needsHelp:!!d.needsHelp}}state.subject=c.subject;state.mode=d.mode;store();refresh();return}
 if(d.type==='st170-next'&&c.unitIds.includes(d.unit)){state.sessionBySubject[c.subject]={unit:d.unit,stage:0};state.subject=c.subject;store();refresh();return}
 if(d.type==='st170-confidence'&&c.unitIds.includes(d.unit)&&['clear','review'].includes(d.value)){const list=Array.isArray(state.reviewBySubject[c.subject])?state.reviewBySubject[c.subject]:[];state.reviewBySubject[c.subject]=d.value==='review'?Array.from(new Set([...list,d.unit])):list.filter(id=>id!==d.unit);store();refresh();return}
 if(d.type==='st170-complete'){state.sessionBySubject[c.subject]={unit:c.unitIds.at(-1),stage:0};state.finishedCourses[c.subject]=true;store();refresh();return}
});
function arrange(){
 const hero=document.getElementById('v90Hero'),el=document.getElementById('st170Launch');if(!hero||!el)return;
 const lede=hero.querySelector('.v90-lede');if(lede&&lede.nextElementSibling!==el)lede.after(el);
 const spark=hero.querySelector('#st160-spark');
 if(spark&&!spark.closest('.st173-more')){
  const more=document.createElement('details');more.className='st173-more';
  const title=document.createElement('summary');title.textContent='Try something different';
  more.append(title);spark.before(more);more.append(spark);
 }
}
/* No extra daily check-in screens: a due lesson comes up on Continue. */
const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{mount();arrange();quickButton();wireLearningHome()});
function boot(){mount();quickButton();wireLearningHome();observer.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true})}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
window.studyTableAutopilot={version:182,start:launch,review,setMode:setDifficulty,inspect:()=>({state,pending})};
})();

</script><script id="st183-home-verbs">/* A shortcut on the existing learning card; no extra dashboard. */
(()=>{'use strict';
let btn;
function sync(){const home=document.getElementById('st170Launch');if(!home)return;
 const subject=home.querySelector('#st170Subject');if(!subject)return;
 if(!btn){btn=document.createElement('button');btn.id='st183HomeVerbs';btn.type='button';btn.textContent='Practice Spanish verbs';btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!window.studyTableFullCourses?.open)return;
  window.studyTableFullCourses.open('spanish');
  const frame=document.getElementById('frame');if(!frame)return;
  const send=()=>{try{frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'st183-verbs-open'},'*')}catch{}};
  frame.addEventListener('load',send,{once:true});setTimeout(send,200);
 });const buttons=home.querySelector('.st170-home-buttons');if(buttons)buttons.append(btn)}
 btn.hidden=subject.value!=='spanish';}
const FIRST={spanish:'spanish-0',piano:'st183-piano-01',chess:'st183-chess-01',calculus:'st183-calculus-01',physics:'st183-physics-01',medicine:'st183-medicine-01',business:'st183-business-01'};
let basics;
function basicsButton(){
 const home=document.getElementById('st170Launch');const subject=home?.querySelector('#st170Subject');
 if(!subject)return;
 if(!basics){basics=document.createElement('button');basics.id='st183Basics';basics.type='button';basics.textContent='Start from the beginning';
 basics.addEventListener('click',()=>{const s=subject.value;if(FIRST[s]&&window.studyTableAutopilot?.start)window.studyTableAutopilot.start({unit:FIRST[s],mode:'easy',skipReview:true})});
 const settings=home.querySelector('#st175Settings');if(settings)settings.append(basics)}
}
const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{sync();basicsButton()});
function boot(){sync();basicsButton();observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['value']});document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target?.id==='st170Subject')sync()})}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();
</script><script id="st200-home">/* An optional review button in the existing settings, not an extra home-screen card. */
(()=>{'use strict';let button;
function mount(){const home=document.querySelector('#st170Launch');const settings=document.querySelector('#st175Settings');const sel=home?.querySelector('#st170Subject');if(!settings||!sel)return;
 if(!button){button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.id='st200-home-review';button.textContent='Review five things';button.style.cssText='margin:12px 8px 8px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #b2cbb9;background:#edf6ee;color:#24543b;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer';button.onclick=()=>{const sub=home.querySelector('#st170Subject')?.value;if(!['spanish','piano','calculus','physics'].includes(sub))return;
 window.studyTableFullCourses?.open(sub);let frame=document.getElementById('frame');if(!frame)return;const send=()=>{try{frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({type:'st200-review-open'},'*')}catch{}};frame.addEventListener('load',send,{once:true});setTimeout(send,300);
 };settings.append(button)}button.hidden=!['spanish','piano','calculus','physics'].includes(sel.value)}
function boot(){mount();const host=document.getElementById('st170Launch');if(host){new MutationObserver(mount).observe(host,{subtree:true,childList:true});host.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target?.id==='st170Subject')mount()})}else setTimeout(boot,300)}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();
</script><script id="st205-unified">

Name the event.","answer":"promotion","hint":"The pawn has reached its last rank.","why":"A pawn reaching the farthest rank must promote immediately."}],[{"prompt":"You win a rook (about five points) but lose a bishop (about three). Is that a net material gain or loss?","answer":"gain","hint":"Compare 5 gained with 3 lost.","why":"The simple material tally is +2, a gain, though position can matter more."},{"prompt":"An undefended queen can be captured by your rook. Which question should you ask first: Is the capture legal, or how much is the queen worth?","answer":"is the capture legal","hint":"Check king safety before counting points.","why":"A valuable capture is irrelevant if it leaves your own king in check."}],[{"prompt":"A passed pawn is one move from promotion but its advance square is occupied by your piece. Can it advance now?","answer":"no","hint":"Pawns do not move forward into occupied squares.","why":"A passed pawn still obeys ordinary pawn movement; your own piece blocks it."},{"prompt":"A pawn promotes on the last rank. Can you choose a rook instead of a queen?","answer":"yes","hint":"Promotion has four legal piece choices.","why":"A rook is a legal promotion choice."}],[{"prompt":"In your game review, you find a move that lost your queen. Is this likely worth examining before memorizing an opening novelty?","answer":"yes","hint":"Focus on the biggest error first.","why":"Preventing an outright queen loss usually matters far more for beginner improvement."},{"prompt":"You were in check, but your last move ignored it. Was that move legal?","answer":"no","hint":"All legal moves must end check.","why":"A move that leaves your own king attacked is illegal."}]],"calculus":[[{"prompt":"A taxi costs $3 plus $2 per mile. What is the cost at five miles?","answer":"13","hint":"Use 3 + 2 × 5.","why":"The fixed fee is 3 and the variable charge is 10: total 13."},{"prompt":"A line runs from (1,3) to (3,9). What is its slope?","answer":"3","hint":"Calculate (9−3)/(3−1).","why":"The rise is 6, the run is 2, so slope = 3."}],[{"prompt":"If s(t)=t² meters, what is the velocity at t=3 seconds?","answer":"6","hint":"Differentiate to get v(t)=2t.","why":"v(t)=2t, so v(3)=6 meters per second."},{"prompt":"What is the derivative of 5x³?","answer":"15x²","hint":"Multiply by exponent 3, then lower power by 1.","why":"The power rule gives 5×3x² = 15x²."}],[{"prompt":"For f(x)=−x²+4x, at what x does the derivative equal zero?","answer":"2","hint":"f′(x)=−2x+4.","why":"Set −2x+4=0 to get x=2; the parabola peaks there."},{"prompt":"For f(x)=x², is the point x=0 a local minimum or maximum?","answer":"minimum","hint":"The graph opens upward.","why":"x² is never negative and equals zero at x=0, so it is a minimum."}],[{"prompt":"What is the derivative of 3sin(x)?","answer":"3cos(x)","hint":"Keep the constant multiplier.","why":"The constant-multiple rule gives d[3sin x]/dx=3cos x."},{"prompt":"At x=0 radians, what is the derivative of sin(x)?","answer":"1","hint":"Derivative is cos(x); cos(0)=1.","why":"d(sin x)/dx=cos x, so at 0 the slope is 1."}],[{"prompt":"If eˣ=1, what is x?","answer":"0","hint":"e raised to zero is one.","why":"Take ln: x=ln 1=0."},{"prompt":"If ln(x)=2, express x using e.","answer":"e²","hint":"Exponentiate both sides using base e.","why":"The inverse of ln gives x=e²."}],[{"prompt":"What is the area under y=3 from x=1 to x=5?","answer":"12","hint":"Height 3; width 5−1=4.","why":"Integral 3 dx from 1 to 5 = 3×4 = 12."},{"prompt":"What is the indefinite integral of 4x with respect to x, omitting the constant?","answer":"2x²","hint":"Reverse the derivative of 2x².","why":"Integral 4x dx=2x²+C, so without the constant it is 2x²."}]],"physics":[[{"prompt":"You walk 24 meters in 6 seconds at steady speed. How many m/s?","answer":"4","hint":"Divide distance by time.","why":"24 m ÷ 6 s = 4 m/s."},{"prompt":"A car travels at constant velocity. Is its acceleration zero?","answer":"yes","hint":"Acceleration is change in velocity.","why":"Constant velocity means no change in velocity, so acceleration is zero."}],[{"prompt":"A 5 kg box accelerates at 2 m/s². Net force in newtons?","answer":"10","hint":"F=ma.","why":"5 kg × 2 m/s² = 10 N."},{"prompt":"A 12 N net force acts on a 3 kg object. Acceleration in m/s²?","answer":"4","hint":"a=F/m.","why":"12/3 = 4 m/s²."}],[{"prompt":"A 6 V battery is connected to a 3 Ω resistor. Current in amps?","answer":"2","hint":"I=V/R.","why":"6 V ÷ 3 Ω = 2 A."},{"prompt":"Two 5 Ω resistors are in series. Total resistance in ohms?","answer":"10","hint":"Series resistances add.","why":"5 Ω + 5 Ω = 10 Ω."}],[{"prompt":"A ball is launched horizontally. Ignoring air resistance, does gravity change its horizontal speed?","answer":"no","hint":"Gravity acts vertically in this model.","why":"Horizontal acceleration is zero while gravity changes vertical velocity."},{"prompt":"At the top of a vertical throw, is vertical velocity momentarily zero?","answer":"yes","hint":"The ball changes from going up to down.","why":"Vertical velocity equals zero at the instant of the highest point, though acceleration remains downward."}],[{"prompt":"A force of 5 N acts 2 m from a pivot at right angles. Torque magnitude in N·m?","answer":"10","hint":"τ = force × perpendicular lever arm.","why":"5 N × 2 m = 10 N·m."},{"prompt":"If you double the perpendicular distance from pivot with unchanged force, torque doubles. Yes or no?","answer":"yes","hint":"Torque is proportional to lever arm.","why":"τ=rF sinθ; with the same angle and force, doubling r doubles torque."}],[{"prompt":"A 12 V lamp draws 2 A. Electrical power in watts?","answer":"24","hint":"P=VI.","why":"12 V × 2 A = 24 W."},{"prompt":"A 100 W bulb runs for two hours. Energy used in watt-hours?","answer":"200","hint":"Energy = power × time.","why":"100 W × 2 h = 200 Wh."}]],"medicine":[[{"prompt":"Red blood cells mainly help deliver which gas to body tissues?","answer":"oxygen","hint":"Think of hemoglobin.","why":"Hemoglobin in red blood cells transports oxygen from lungs to tissues."},{"prompt":"Which organ pumps blood through the body?","answer":"heart","hint":"It contains four chambers.","why":"The heart drives pulmonary and systemic circulation."}],[{"prompt":"Which side of the heart pumps blood toward the lungs?","answer":"right","hint":"Pulmonary circulation starts in the right ventricle.","why":"The right ventricle pumps deoxygenated blood to the pulmonary arteries and lungs."},{"prompt":"Which heart chamber pumps oxygenated blood into the aorta?","answer":"left ventricle","hint":"It is the thick-walled main systemic pump.","why":"The left ventricle ejects blood into the aorta."}],[{"prompt":"When body temperature rises, sweating helps cool it. Is this positive or negative feedback?","answer":"negative feedback","hint":"The response opposes the initial increase.","why":"Sweating reduces temperature, opposing the disturbance: negative feedback."},{"prompt":"When blood glucose falls, glucagon tends to raise it. Does this oppose or amplify the drop?","answer":"oppose","hint":"The hormone helps restore the set range.","why":"Glucagon raises blood glucose and counteracts the fall."}],[{"prompt":"A group of similar cells working together is a tissue or an organ?","answer":"tissue","hint":"Organs contain multiple tissue types.","why":"Similar cells organized for a shared function make a tissue."},{"prompt":"The stomach contains muscular, nervous and epithelial tissue. Is the stomach an organ or a cell?","answer":"organ","hint":"Several tissues build a larger functional structure.","why":"The stomach is an organ made of different tissues."}],[{"prompt":"If thyroid hormone rises, what usually happens to pituitary TSH through negative feedback?","answer":"decrease","hint":"More downstream hormone suppresses the upstream signal.","why":"High T3/T4 usually suppresses pituitary TSH release."},{"prompt":"What pituitary hormone stimulates the thyroid gland?","answer":"TSH","hint":"The abbreviation stands for thyroid-stimulating hormone.","why":"TSH from the anterior pituitary stimulates thyroid hormone synthesis and release."}],[{"prompt":"A test has many false positives in a low-risk population. Does a positive result always prove disease?","answer":"no","hint":"Predictive value depends on baseline prevalence.","why":"A positive test changes probability; it is not proof of disease."},{"prompt":"A highly sensitive test comes back negative. Is that generally more useful for ruling OUT disease or ruling IN disease?","answer":"ruling out","hint":"A sensitive test misses fewer cases.","why":"A negative result on a highly sensitive test often helps rule out a condition, depending on context."}]],"business":[[{"prompt":"Price is $20, variable cost $12. Contribution per unit in dollars?","answer":"8","hint":"Subtract variable cost from selling price.","why":"20−12=$8 per unit before fixed costs."},{"prompt":"You sell 10 units at $15 each. Revenue in dollars?","answer":"150","hint":"Multiply unit price by units sold.","why":"10×15=$150 revenue, before costs."}],[{"prompt":"Total fixed cost is $100 for 10 units. Fixed cost per unit?","answer":"10","hint":"Divide total fixed cost by volume.","why":"100/10=$10 fixed cost per unit at that volume."},{"prompt":"Fixed cost remains $100 but sales double to 20 units. Fixed cost per unit?","answer":"5","hint":"Same fixed pool spread over more units.","why":"100/20=$5 per unit; average unit cost changes with volume."}],[{"prompt":"Customer generates $80 contribution before acquisition expense. CAC is $30. Contribution after CAC?","answer":"50","hint":"Subtract acquisition cost from contribution.","why":"80−30=$50 remains, before other overhead and timing."},{"prompt":"If one acquired customer brings $40 gross contribution and CAC is $60, is first-order contribution after CAC positive?","answer":"no","hint":"40−60 is negative.","why":"The first order contributes −$20 after CAC; future orders may change lifetime economics."}],[{"prompt":"Ten leads yield two signed deals. Close rate as a whole percentage?","answer":"20","hint":"2 divided by 10 then multiply by 100.","why":"2/10 = 20% close rate."},{"prompt":"You expect 5 deals at $1,000 each. Forecasted booked revenue?","answer":"5000","hint":"Deals times average value.","why":"5 × $1,000 = $5,000, assuming the forecast closes."}],[{"prompt":"A two-item bundle sells for $30 and variable cost totals $18. Contribution margin in dollars?","answer":"12","hint":"Selling price less total variable cost.","why":"30−18=$12 contribution per bundle."},{"prompt":"You discount a $50 item to $40 and cost stays $25. New contribution in dollars?","answer":"15","hint":"New price minus unchanged variable cost.","why":"40−25=$15 contribution after discount."}],[{"prompt":"You invoice a client $2,000 payable next month. Did that invoice alone bring in $2,000 cash today?","answer":"no","hint":"Revenue booked and cash collected can occur at different times.","why":"An unpaid invoice is a receivable, not cash in the bank."},{"prompt":"You have $1,000 cash and a $600 bill due today. Cash left after payment in dollars?","answer":"400","hint":"Subtract the cash outflow.","why":"1,000−600=$400 remains, regardless of unpaid sales invoices."}]]};
const COACH={"piano":["Look for groups of two and three black keys. They give every white key an address. Count note values as time, not loudness.","Read the staff from its bottom line upward, then map the letter to the physical keyboard. A whole step is two semitones.","Hands can split a chord or rhythm. Start with separate hands, then play together slowly on an even count.","Silence still takes time. Keep the beat going through rests; add every note and rest until you reach the bar length.","Scales repeat letters in order. In C major there are no sharps or flats. Build basic triads with alternate scale tones.","Subdivide each beat into two even halves: “one-and, two-and.” Accents on the “ands” create offbeat feel.","Work one measure at a time; count steadily through every bar. Repeat the passage slowly before speeding it up."],"chess":["The game ends with checkmate, not king capture. Before a move, look at what squares your king and pieces control.","A king cannot move into attack. “Not in check” differs from “no legal moves”: that difference separates stalemate and mate.","When in check, stop your plan and respond: move the king, capture the checker, or block a sliding attack.","Castling is a two-square king move plus a rook move. The king cannot start in, pass through, or end in check.","Promotion can change the whole game. A passed pawn has no opposing pawns ahead on its file or adjacent files.","Count attackers and defenders, but also piece values, move order, and whether your own king would be exposed.","A passed pawn needs a path and support. Sometimes a rook promotion or knight underpromotion is better than a queen.","Review the first meaningful mistake, not every move. Ask what threat you missed and what check you should have made."],"calculus":["A function connects inputs to outputs. Evaluate it by substituting a number; slope is change in output over change in input.","A derivative describes an instantaneous rate. Differentiate first, then substitute the requested input.","A stationary point often has derivative zero, but classify it using the graph, slope signs, or second derivative.","Sine and cosine cycle. In radians, the derivative of sine is cosine; a constant multiplier stays outside.","Natural log undoes exponentiation with base e. Treat ln and e^ as inverse operations.","An integral accumulates quantities; for a constant rate, total is rate × interval width. An antiderivative reverses differentiation."],"physics":["Always write the units. Speed is distance divided by time; acceleration is how quickly velocity changes.","Newton’s second law links net force, mass, and acceleration. A motionless object and a constant-velocity object can both have zero net force.","Voltage drives current through resistance. For a resistor, I=V/R; series resistances add.","Horizontal and vertical motions can be analyzed separately without air drag. Gravity acts downward even at the very top.","Torque depends on force AND lever arm AND angle. A distant force can turn an object more effectively than a nearby force.","Electrical power is energy per time. Calculate P=VI; multiply watts by hours to estimate watt-hours."],"medicine":["Work from function to structure: oxygen delivery, circulation, and energy support the body’s cells. These are basic science examples, not medical advice.","Trace blood: right heart → lungs → left heart → body. Right/left describe the patient’s sides.","Negative feedback opposes a change: when a value drifts, the response tends to restore it.","Organization scales up: cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs work in systems.","The hypothalamus–pituitary–thyroid axis is a feedback loop. The pituitary produces TSH; thyroid hormone usually suppresses it.","Tests update probability; they do not independently establish certainty. Sensitivity, specificity, and prevalence all matter."],"business":["Distinguish revenue from contribution: selling price minus variable cost is the amount left to cover fixed costs and profit.","Average fixed cost depends on volume. Don’t mistake average total unit cost for a truly variable cost of the next sale.","CAC is spent to acquire customers. Evaluate that outlay against contribution and timing, not top-line revenue alone.","Forecast from assumptions you can audit: lead volume, win rate, deal size, close timing. A forecast is not cash received.","Discounts cut contribution unless costs fall too. Bundle math requires all variable costs, not just the headline price.","An invoice is not a bank deposit. Model when money arrives and when bills leave, so profitable sales don’t create cash surprises."]};
for(const [subject,chapters] of Object.entries(EXTRA))for(let i=0;i<chapters.length;i++)BANK[subject][i].push(...chapters[i]);
const COURSE_NAMES={piano:'Piano',chess:'Chess',calculus:'Calculus',physics:'Physics',medicine:'Medicine',business:'Business'};
const CHAPTER_TITLES={"piano":["Before you play a note","Connect a note on the staff to a key","Give each hand a small job","Keep counting when the sound stops","Play a C major scale without changing fingers","Count an eighth note without losing the beat","Play a complete eight-bar arrangement"],"chess":["What are you trying to do?","Keep your king safe","Answer a check and inspect an ordinary threat","Castle only after checking the king’s route","Count whether the king can catch a pawn","Count attackers before taking","Make a passed pawn matter","Review one game without drowning in analysis"],"calculus":["Before calculus: numbers that can change","From average speed to a derivative","Use a derivative to choose the best outcome","Differentiate a sine wave","Use logs to undo an exponential","See accumulation as a new function"],"physics":["Before physics: describe what happened","What makes a cart speed up?","Why current changes when resistance changes","Separate horizontal and vertical motion","Keep torque separate from force","Calculate electrical power"],"medicine":["Before medicine: what the body needs","Two circuits, one pump","A control loop that can fail in two ways","Go from cells to tissues to organs","Follow the thyroid feedback loop","Read a test using odds, not gut feeling"],"business":["Before business: a sale in three numbers","Average cost is an answer, not an input","What a customer is worth, and what you can pay for one","Make a sales forecast you can actually use","Price a bundle using contribution margin","Plan cash for a slow-paying customer"]};
const ONE_DAY=24*60*60*1000;
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let session=null, lastFocus=null, audio=null, saveWarning='';
function make(tag,cls,txt){const n=document.createElement(tag);if(cls)n.className=cls;if(txt!==undefined)n.textContent=txt;return n}
function action(label,fn,cls=''){const b=make('button',cls,label);b.type='button';b.onclick=fn;return b}
function safeLoad(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(!raw)return {version:1,chapters:{}};const value=JSON.parse(raw);if(validate(value))return value}catch{}return {version:1,chapters:{}}}
let state=safeLoad();
function validate(s){if(!s||s.version!==1||!s.chapters||typeof s.chapters!=='object'||Array.isArray(s.chapters)||Object.keys(s.chapters).length>50)return false;
 for(const [key,row] of Object.entries(s.chapters)){const [sub,index]=key.split(':');if(!BANK[sub]||!/^\d+$/.test(index)||!BANK[sub][Number(index)]||!row||typeof row!=='object'||!Number.isInteger(row.attempts)||row.attempts<1||row.attempts>1e6||!Number.isInteger(row.independent)||row.independent<0||row.independent>(row.total||2)||![undefined,2,4].includes(row.total)||((row.streak!==undefined)&&(!Number.isInteger(row.streak)||row.streak<0||row.streak>10000))||typeof row.last!=='string'||typeof row.due!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(row.last))||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(row.due)))return false}return true}
function safeSave(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));saveWarning=''}catch{saveWarning='This browser cannot save chapter-check progress. Your work will last only until this page closes.'}}
function dueCount(){return Object.values(state.chapters).filter(r=>Date.parse(r.due)<=Date.now()).length}
function completedCount(){return Object.keys(state.chapters).length}
function norm(str){return String(str||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[−–—]/g,'-').replace(/²/g,'^2').replace(/×/g,'x').replace(/\$/g,'').replace(/[!?.,:;\s]+/g,' ').trim()}
const ALIASES={
 'at the same moment':['same time','together','when previous note ends','at same time','as previous note ends'],
 'move block capture':['move king block capture','move the king block the check or capture the attacker','king move block capture'],
 'first critical mistake':['critical mistake','turning point','first big mistake'],
 'plasma membrane':['cell membrane','the plasma membrane'],
 'right ventricle':['right ventricular chamber','the right ventricle'],
 'left ventricle':['left ventricular chamber','the left ventricle'],
 'oxygen transport':['carry oxygen','transport oxygen','carrying oxygen'],
 'fall':['decrease','go down','lower'],
 'decrease':['lower','fall','go down'],
 'oppose':['counteract','reverse','reduce','opposes'],
 'passed pawn':['passed'],
 'promotion':['promote','promotes'],
 'checkmate':['mate'],
 'blunder':['serious error','big mistake'],
 'greater':['higher','increase','larger'],
 'syncopation':['syncopated rhythm'],
 '0':['zero'], '1':['one'], '2':['two'], '3':['three'], '4':['four'], '5':['five'], '6':['six'],
 '8':['eight'], '10':['ten'], '14':['fourteen'], '20':['twenty'], '24':['twenty four'], '120':['one hundred twenty'],
 'no':['not allowed','cannot','never','false'],
 'yes':['true','it can','correct'],
 '2x':['2*x','2 x'],
 '-sin(x)':['-sin x','negative sine x','negative sin x'],
 'cos(x)':['cos x','cosine x'],
 'ln(5)':['ln 5','log base e of 5'],
 'c e g':['c-e-g','c, e, g','c major triad'],
 'a c e':['a-c-e','a minor chord','a minor'],
 'c':['middle c','c4'],
 'newton':['newtons','n'],
 'pituitary':['pituitary gland','anterior pituitary']
};
function matches(input,ans){const got=norm(input),want=norm(ans);if(!got)return false;if(got===want||norm(got.replace(/\*/g,''))===want)return true;
 if((ALIASES[want]||[]).some(s=>norm(s)===got))return true;
 if(/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(want)){
   const m=got.match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*(?:beats?|units?|dollars?|m\/s|m\/s\^2|n|n m|amperes?|amps?|a|w|watts?|wh|watt hours?|\$))?$/);
   if(m&&Number(m[1])===Number(want))return true;
 }
 return false;
}
function chapterKey(sub,i){return sub+':'+i}
function restoreHub(){const pane=byId('st207Pane'),body=byId('st205Body');if(pane){pane.hidden=true;pane.replaceChildren()}if(body)body.style.display='block';session=null;bindHub()}
function viewPane(){const dlg=byId('st205Hub'),body=byId('st205Body');if(!dlg||!body)return null;body.style.display='none';byId('st205Studio').style.display='none';let p=byId('st207Pane');if(!p){p=make('div','st207-pane');p.id='st207Pane';dlg.append(p)}p.hidden=false;p.replaceChildren();return p}
function topbar(p,heading){const row=make('div','st207-toolbar');row.append(action('← Courses',restoreHub,'st207-secondary'),make('strong','',heading));p.append(row)}
function note(p,txt){p.append(make('p','st207-note',txt))}
function renderCheck(){const s=session;if(!s)return;const p=viewPane();if(!p)return;
 topbar(p,COURSE_NAMES[s.subject]+' · Chapter '+(s.chapter+1));const header=make('div','st207-heading');header.append(make('span','st207-eyebrow','Question '+(s.index+1)+' of '+s.questions.length),make('h2','',CHAPTER_TITLES[s.subject][s.chapter]));p.append(header);
 const q=s.questions[s.index];
 const stage=make('p','st209-stage',s.index<2?'1 · Check the idea':'2 · Use the idea');p.append(stage);
 const teach=make('details','st209-teach');const summary=make('summary','','Teach me this chapter first');teach.append(summary,make('p','',COACH[s.subject][s.chapter]));p.append(teach);
 const prompt=make('p','st207-prompt',q.prompt);p.append(prompt);
 if(s.subject==='piano')addKeyboard(p);
 const label=make('label','st207-input-label','Your short answer');label.setAttribute('for','st207Answer');p.append(label);
 const input=make('input','st207-input');input.id='st207Answer';input.type='text';input.autocomplete='off';input.spellcheck=false;input.maxLength=120;input.placeholder='Type a number, note, or short phrase';p.append(input);
 const feedback=make('div','st207-feedback');feedback.setAttribute('role','status');feedback.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');p.append(feedback);
 const actions=make('div','st207-actions'),check=action('Check answer',()=>submit()),hint=action('Small hint',()=>{s.assisted=true;feedback.textContent=q.hint;feedback.dataset.status='hint'},'st207-secondary'),show=action('Show answer and reasoning',()=>{s.assisted=true;feedback.textContent=q.answer+' — '+q.why;feedback.dataset.status='teach';check.disabled=true;input.disabled=true;actions.replaceChildren(action('Continue',()=>advance(false)))},'st207-secondary');actions.append(check,hint,show);p.append(actions);
 function submit(){const value=input.value.trim();if(!value){feedback.textContent='Enter an answer, or choose a hint.';feedback.dataset.status='hint';return}
  if(matches(value,q.answer)){const independent=!s.assisted&&!s.wrong;s.results.push(independent);feedback.textContent=(independent?'Correct on your own. ':'Correct after practice. ')+q.why;feedback.dataset.status='ok';check.disabled=true;input.disabled=true;actions.replaceChildren(action(s.index===s.questions.length-1?'See chapter result':'Next question',()=>advance(true)))}
  else{s.wrong=true;feedback.textContent='I cannot verify that as the expected short answer. '+q.hint+' You can try again or compare with the worked answer.';feedback.dataset.status='try'}
 }
 input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!check.disabled){e.preventDefault();submit()}});
 input.focus();
}
function advance(correct){if(!session)return;if(!correct)session.results.push(false);session.index++;session.assisted=false;session.wrong=false;if(session.index<session.questions.length)renderCheck();else finish()}
function startCheck(sub,chapter){if(!BANK[sub]||!BANK[sub][chapter])return;state=safeLoad();lastFocus=document.activeElement;session={subject:sub,chapter,index:0,questions:BANK[sub][chapter],results:[],assisted:false,wrong:false};renderCheck()}
function finish(){const s=session,p=viewPane();if(!p)return;topbar(p,COURSE_NAMES[s.subject]+' · Chapter '+(s.chapter+1));const got=s.results.filter(Boolean).length,total=s.results.length,pass=got===total;
 p.append(make('div','st207-eyebrow','Chapter check complete'));
 p.append(make('h2','',pass?'You got all four independently':'Here is what to work on next'));
 p.append(make('p','st207-prompt',got+' of '+total+' first-try correct, without hints. '+(pass?'Nice work. You can move on or review later.':'Review the examples below, then give this chapter another try.')));
 const now=Date.now(),key=chapterKey(s.subject,s.chapter),prior=state.chapters[key];
 const streak=pass?(prior?.streak||0)+1:0;
 const days=pass?(streak===1?3:streak===2?7:14):1;
 state.chapters[key]={attempts:(prior?.attempts||0)+1,independent:got,total,streak,last:new Date(now).toISOString(),due:new Date(now+days*ONE_DAY).toISOString()};safeSave();
 if(saveWarning)note(p,saveWarning);
 note(p,pass?'Next spaced review in '+days+' days. A second independent success increases the interval.':'Next review in one day. Practice again now if you want to work on the missed ideas.');
 if(!pass){const review=make('div','st209-misses');review.append(make('h3','','Your review notes'));
 s.questions.forEach((q,i)=>{if(s.results[i])return;const card=make('div','st209-miss');card.append(make('strong','','Question '+(i+1)+': '+q.prompt),make('p','','Expected: '+q.answer),make('p','',q.why));review.append(card)});p.append(review)}
 const buttons=make('div','st207-actions');buttons.append(action('Practice again',()=>startCheck(s.subject,s.chapter)),action('Back to courses',restoreHub,'st207-secondary'));p.append(buttons);
 note(p,'These short checks support learning. They are not proof of professional, musical, medical, or mathematical proficiency.');
 refreshDashboard();
}
function addKeyboard(p){const wrap=make('section','st207-keys-wrap');wrap.append(make('span','st207-eyebrow','Try the notes on this mini keyboard'));const keys=make('div','st207-keys');const notes=[['C4',261.63],['C#4',277.18],['D4',293.66],['D#4',311.13],['E4',329.63],['F4',349.23],['F#4',369.99],['G4',392],['G#4',415.30],['A4',440],['A#4',466.16],['B4',493.88],['C5',523.25]];
 notes.forEach(([name,f])=>{const b=action(name,()=>play(f),name.includes('#')?'st207-black':'st207-white');b.setAttribute('aria-label','Play '+name);keys.append(b)});wrap.append(keys);p.append(wrap)}
function play(freq){try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C)return;audio ||=new C();if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume();const t=audio.currentTime,o=audio.createOscillator(),gain=audio.createGain();o.type='triangle';o.frequency.value=freq;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.12,t+.02);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.65);o.connect(gain).connect(audio.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.67)}catch{}}
function refreshDashboard(){const text=byId('st207ReviewCount');if(text)text.textContent='Review chapters ('+dueCount()+' due · '+completedCount()+' practiced)'}
function showReview(){const p=viewPane();if(!p)return;topbar(p,'Your chapter reviews');p.append(make('h2','','Pick up where you left off'));
 note(p,'A chapter returns tomorrow if you used help or missed an answer. Four independent answers stretch the next review from 3 to 7 to 14 days. All original lessons remain available.');
 const completed=Object.entries(state.chapters).map(([id,row])=>{const [sub,i]=id.split(':');return {sub,index:Number(i),row}})
 .filter(x=>!!BANK[x.sub]?.[x.index]).sort((a,b)=>Date.parse(a.row.due)-Date.parse(b.row.due));
 const due=completed.filter(x=>Date.parse(x.row.due)<=Date.now());
 if(!completed.length)note(p,'No checks yet. Start with one chapter in any course.');
 else note(p,due.length+' due now · '+(completed.length-due.length)+' scheduled. You can practice any chapter early.');
 const list=make('div','st207-review-list');p.append(list);
 for(const entry of completed){const isDue=Date.parse(entry.row.due)<=Date.now();
  const date=new Date(entry.row.due).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric'});
  const label=(isDue?'Due · ':'Review '+date+' · ')+COURSE_NAMES[entry.sub]+' · Chapter '+(entry.index+1)+' · '+CHAPTER_TITLES[entry.sub][entry.index]+' ('+entry.row.independent+'/'+(entry.row.total||2)+')';
  const b=action(label,()=>startCheck(entry.sub,entry.index),'st207-review-row');list.append(b)}
 const tools=make('div','st207-actions');tools.append(action('Back to courses',restoreHub,'st207-secondary'));p.append(tools);if(saveWarning)note(p,saveWarning)
}
function bindHub(){if(!session)state=safeLoad();const dlg=byId('st205Hub'),chapters=byId('st205Chapters');if(!dlg||!chapters)return;
 const subjectNav=byId('st205Subjects');if(subjectNav&&!subjectNav.querySelector('.st207-books-link')){const book=action('Books & Reading',()=>{dlg.close();const go=document.querySelector('#subjects button[data-subject=books]');if(go)go.click();else alert('Open Books & Reading in the original subject sidebar.');},'st207-books-link');book.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');subjectNav.append(book)}
 const chosen=[...byId('st205Subjects').querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true');const sub=chosen?.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();if(!BANK[sub])return;
 [...chapters.querySelectorAll(':scope > section')].forEach((section,i)=>{if(!BANK[sub][i])return;const prior=state.chapters[chapterKey(sub,i)],count=prior?' · '+prior.independent+'/' +(prior.total||2)+' first-try':' · '+BANK[sub][i].length+' questions';const label='Check your understanding'+count;const existing=section.querySelector('.st207-chapter-check');if(existing){if(existing.textContent!==label)existing.textContent=label;return;}section.append(action(label,()=>startCheck(sub,i),'st207-chapter-check'))});
 refreshDashboard()
}
function addPortalLink(){const portal=byId('v35Portal');if(!portal)return false;const host=byId('v35Content');if(!host)return false;const add=()=>{const h=host.querySelector('.v36-head-actions')||host.querySelector('.v35-head');if(!h||h.querySelector('.st207-portal-link'))return;const b=action('My courses & chapter checks',()=>{byId('v35Exit')?.click();window.setTimeout(()=>byId('st205Open')?.click(),0)},'st207-portal-link');h.append(b)};new MutationObserver(add).observe(host,{childList:true,subtree:true});add();return true}
function install(){const dlg=byId('st205Hub');if(!dlg||dlg.dataset.st207)return;dlg.dataset.st207='1';const bar=byId('st205Top');if(!bar)return;
 const b=action('Review chapters',showReview,'st207-review-launch');b.id='st207ReviewCount';bar.insertBefore(b,byId('st205Close'));
 const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>bindHub());observer.observe(byId('st205Chapters'),{childList:true,subtree:true});observer.observe(byId('st205Subjects'),{attributes:true,childList:true,subtree:true,attributeFilter:['aria-pressed']});dlg.addEventListener('close',restoreHub);bindHub();if(!addPortalLink()){const watch=new MutationObserver(()=>{if(addPortalLink())watch.disconnect()});watch.observe(document.body,{childList:true})}
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
window.StudyTableChapterChecks={testAnswer:(sub,chapter,index,answer)=>!!BANK[sub]?.[chapter]?.[index]&&matches(answer,BANK[sub][chapter][index].answer),getState:()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)),getBank:()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BANK)),reload:()=>{state=safeLoad();refreshDashboard();bindHub();return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state))},count:()=>Object.values(BANK).reduce((n,chs)=>n+chs.reduce((k,q)=>k+q.length,0),0),open:startCheck,validate};
})();


</script>
<script id="st209-review-backup">
(()=>{'use strict';
const KEY='studytable:v207:chapter-checks';
function valid(x){return x&&x.version===1&&x.chapters&&typeof x.chapters==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x.chapters)}
function snapshot(){try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));return valid(x)?x:null}catch{return null}}
function download(){const data=snapshot();if(!data){alert('No chapter checks saved yet. Finish one chapter check first.');return}const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({kind:'study-table-chapter-checks',version:1,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),data},null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='study-table-chapter-reviews.json';document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500)}
function importFile(file){if(!file||file.size>1000000){alert('Choose a chapter-review backup smaller than 1 MB.');return}const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>{try{const wrap=JSON.parse(reader.result);if(wrap.kind!=='study-table-chapter-checks'||wrap.version!==1||!valid(wrap.data))throw Error('Invalid backup');const api=window.StudyTableChapterChecks;if(!api||!api.validate(wrap.data))throw Error('Unsupported review records');const old=snapshot();const count=Object.keys(wrap.data.chapters).length;const oldCount=Object.keys(old?.chapters||{}).length;if(!confirm('Restore '+count+' chapter records? This replaces '+oldCount+' existing chapter records. Export your current reviews first if needed.'))return;localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(wrap.data));api.reload();alert('Chapter reviews restored. Course progress and review dates are now updated.')}catch(e){alert('Could not restore chapter reviews: '+e.message)}};reader.readAsText(file)}
function mount(){const dlg=document.getElementById('st205Hub');if(!dlg)return;const top=document.getElementById('st205Top');if(!top||top.querySelector('.st208-tools'))return;const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='st208-tools';const exp=document.createElement('button');exp.type='button';exp.textContent='Export chapter reviews';exp.onclick=download;const imp=document.createElement('button');imp.type='button';imp.textContent='Restore chapter reviews';const picker=document.createElement('input');picker.type='file';picker.accept='.json,application/json';picker.hidden=true;picker.onchange=()=>{importFile(picker.files?.[0]);picker.value=''};imp.onclick=()=>picker.click();row.append(exp,imp,picker);top.append(row)}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',mount,{once:true});else mount();
window.StudyTableReviewBackup={snapshot,validate:valid};
})();

</script>
</body></html>
